question.prompt: Restore the page-size scenario that proves the `Show` control offers 6, 12, and 20, defaults to 20, and that choosing 6 leaves `<total> book(s) found` unchanged?

options.label: Leave evicted
options.detail: Keep the current three-pair budget cut and leave this page-size path for a later pass.

options.label: Raise budget
options.detail: Increase `max_pairs` above 3 so this scenario can be minted alongside the retained set.

options.label: Swap retained scenario
options.detail: Replace one retained scenario with this page-size scenario; type the retained scenario ref to drop.

content.risk_rationale: This evicted path covered a subtle but narrower control promise: the found count must remain the total number of genre matches even when the page size changes, and choosing 6 must render exactly six tiles. It ranked just below the retained baseline valid-genre path because both sit on the same surface, but the retained path covered more foundational browse guarantees per pair.
